caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing female figure placed on a black, stepped rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a yellowish-tan fringed dress with a green sash and a circular emblem at her waist, featuring a red, white, and green motif with the word “TOBACCO” below it. She wears tan shoes. A red cape drapes over both shoulders, and her tunic includes blue and green coloring on the upper body and around the collar. The figure's hair is long and black, flowing behind her shoulders, and she wears a green headband with three large upright feathers colored yellow, green, and gray. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Cigar Store Indian
